end_to_end.actual: 32/32 project specs pass in both browsers. Live app, both browsers: preflop card read 'Hint / Recommended: Raise to $8 / From the 6-max chart: raise A9o from the cutoff / <explanation> / Ben: typical player, Cal: typical player, Ava: typical player' with no % outside the explanation; postflop card read 'Recommended: Fold / Equity 21.4% / Required equity 22.2% / <explanation> / Cal: typical player' (one line per live opponent). Select Hint to try again.', logged 'Hint could not be worked out', table kept playing; Hide then Hint re-requested (2 requests) and showed a ready card. Loading line 'Working out the hint…' with aria-busy and a delayed reply never reappeared after acting. 10-player live table ('From the full-ring chart: ...') and an 800x600 viewport: card box never intersected the Your actions group or the toggle; every enabled action button passed trial clicks. Axe: no serious/critical violations with preflop, postflop, error and 10-seat cards open.
